description: xl2times is a Python converter maintained by the ETSAP TIMES community for turning Excel-defined energy-system models into inputs that the TIMES and GAMS workflow can process. It reads a supported subset of VEDA-style spreadsheet tags, parses model sets and parameters, and writes prepared TIMES model files. Users supply source workbooks and a conversion configuration; outputs are structured model input artifacts. Geographic coverage and planning years follow the source workbook. MIT source, PyPI installation and examples are public. The README says VEDA support is partial and other spreadsheet conventions are not yet implemented. A limitation is that conversion cannot fix inconsistent model assumptions and the downstream GAMS/TIMES run has separate software requirements. xl2times can help reproduce energy infrastructure investment scenarios described in spreadsheets. The catalogue's model-times-ireland-model is one distinct TIMES case, not a bundled xl2times dataset. No workbook, solver or package was downloaded.
name: xl2times TIMES spreadsheet converter
